title: 1 Chronicles Bible Quiz - Chapter 9
description: Ten questions on 1 Chronicles 9: the people who lived in Jerusalem, the priests, the gatekeepers and the duties of the Levites.

questions.text: Why was Judah carried away captive to Babylon?
questions.explanation: All Israel were listed by genealogies, and Judah was carried away captive to Babylon for their disobedience.

answers.text: Because they lost a battle with Egypt

questions.text: How does verse 13 describe the priests' brothers, the heads of their fathers' houses?
questions.explanation: Their brothers, one thousand seven hundred sixty, were very able men for the work of the service of God's house.

answers.text: Very able men for the service of God's house
Mighty men of valor and archers
Singers who praised day and night

questions.text: Who was the chief of the gatekeepers?
questions.explanation: The gatekeepers were Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, Ahiman and their brothers, and Shallum was the chief.

questions.text: Who was ruler over them in time past, with Yahweh with him?
questions.explanation: Phinehas the son of Eleazar was ruler over them in time past, and Yahweh was with him.

questions.text: Who was gatekeeper of the door of the Tent of Meeting?
questions.explanation: Zechariah the son of Meshelemiah was gatekeeper of the door of the Tent of Meeting.

questions.text: Who ordained the gatekeepers in their office of trust?
questions.explanation: The gatekeepers were listed in their villages, whom David and Samuel the seer ordained in their office of trust.

questions.text: On which sides were the gatekeepers placed?
questions.explanation: On the four sides were the gatekeepers, toward the east, west, north, and south.

answers.text: On the east and west sides only

questions.text: What was Mattithiah, the firstborn of Shallum the Korahite, in charge of?
questions.explanation: Mattithiah, one of the Levites, had the office of trust over the things that were baked in pans.

answers.text: The keys of the city gates
The things that were baked in pans

questions.text: How often did some of the Kohathites prepare the show bread?
questions.explanation: Some of the sons of the Kohathites were over the show bread, to prepare it every Sabbath.

questions.text: Who is named as the father of Gibeon in verse 35?
questions.explanation: Jeiel the father of Gibeon, whose wife's name was Maacah, lived in Gibeon.
